discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has changed medicine through drugs for diabetes and obesity, with large benefits now shown for cardiovascular and kidney outcomes. Habener, Mojsov and Knudsen shared the 2024 Lasker-DeBakey Clinical Award, which often comes before a Nobel. The 2025 prize went to immune tolerance, so a metabolic or clinical topic would be a natural change of field.
